C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 419 U. S. 992.] Motion of the Solicitor General for additional time to permit the Securities and Exchange Commission to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae denied.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.*
